passages.text: These are the words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders of Tekoa—what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Amos spoke these words.
Amos was a shepherd.
He lived in Tekoa.
God gave Amos a vision about Israel.
This happened two years before the earthquake.
Uzziah was king of Judah at that time.
Jeroboam, son of Jehoash, was king of Israel then.
passages.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עָמ֔וֹס אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה בַנֹּקְדִ֖ים מִתְּק֑וֹעַ אֲשֶׁר֩ חָזָ֨ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בִּימֵ֣י׀ עֻזִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבִימֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנָתַ֖יִם לִפְנֵ֥י הָרָֽעַשׁ׃

passages.text: He said: “The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.”
passages.sermon:
Amos was a prophet.
He spoke the words of the LORD.
The LORD is powerful and holy.
The LORD roars from Zion.
Zion is the city of God.
The LORD raises His voice from Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is the holy city.
The pastures of the shepherds mourn.
The summit of Carmel withers.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀ יְהוָה֙ מִצִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֑וֹ וְאָֽבְלוּ֙ נְא֣וֹת הָרֹעִ֔ים וְיָבֵ֖שׁ רֹ֥אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says this about Damascus.
Damascus committed many sins.
Damascus sinned three times.
Damascus sinned a fourth time.
I will not take back my punishment.
Damascus attacked Gilead.
They used iron tools to crush Gilead.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י דַמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ דּוּשָׁ֛ם בַּחֲרֻצ֥וֹת הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks with authority and power.\r\nHe will send fire against the house of Hazael.\r\nThe fire will destroy the strongholds of Ben-hadad.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּבֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־ הֲדָֽד׃

passages.text: I will break down the gates of Damascus; I will cut off the ruler of the Valley of Aven and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden. The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority and power.
The LORD will break down the gates of Damascus.
The LORD will remove the ruler from the Valley of Aven.
The LORD will remove the one who holds the scepter in Beth-eden.
The LORD will send the people of Aram into exile in Kir.
passages.original: וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ בְּרִ֣יחַ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִבִּקְעַת־ אָ֔וֶן וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִבֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן וְגָל֧וּ עַם־ אֲרָ֛ם קִ֖ירָה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they exiled a whole population, delivering them up to Edom.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD says this about Gaza.
Gaza committed three sins.
Gaza committed even a fourth sin.
The LORD will not take back His punishment.
Gaza exiled an entire people.
Gaza handed these people over to Edom.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י עַזָּ֔ה וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ הַגְלוֹתָ֛ם גָּל֥וּת שְׁלֵמָ֖ה לְהַסְגִּ֥יר לֶאֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza, to consume its citadels.
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks.\r\nThe LORD will send fire on the walls of Gaza.\r\nThe fire will destroy the strong buildings of Gaza.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
The Lord GOD promises judgment.
The Lord GOD will cut off the ruler in Ashdod.
The Lord GOD will remove the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon.
The Lord GOD will turn His hand against Ekron.
The Lord GOD will cause the remnant of the Philistines to perish.
passages.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מֵֽאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מֵֽאַשְׁקְל֑וֹן וַהֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜י עַל־ עֶקְר֗וֹן וְאָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD sees all actions.
The LORD says this about Tyre.
Tyre is a city.
Tyre committed many sins.
Tyre sinned three times.
Tyre sinned a fourth time.
The LORD will not take back His judgment against Tyre.
Tyre handed over a whole group of exiles to Edom.
Tyre broke a covenant of brotherhood.
Tyre did not remember their agreement with their brothers.
The LORD will judge Tyre for these actions.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵי־ צֹ֔ר וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־ הַסְגִּירָ֞ם גָּל֤וּת שְׁלֵמָה֙ לֶאֱד֔וֹם וְלֹ֥א זָכְר֖וּ בְּרִ֥ית אַחִֽים׃

passages.text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks.
The Lord will send fire.
The fire will strike the walls of Tyre.
The fire will destroy Tyre’s strong buildings.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּח֣וֹמַת צֹ֑ר וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion; his anger raged continually, and his fury flamed incessantly.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD says this about Edom.
Edom is a nation.
Edom committed many sins.
Edom sinned three times.
Edom sinned a fourth time.
The LORD will not turn back His judgment against Edom.
Edom chased his brother with a sword.
Edom showed no compassion.
Edom’s anger never stopped.
Edom’s fury burned without end.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ רָדְפ֨וֹ בַחֶ֤רֶב אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת רַחֲמָ֔יו וַיִּטְרֹ֤ף לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ שְׁמָ֥רָה נֶֽצַח׃

passages.text: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.”
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks.\r\nThe LORD will send fire on Teman.\r\nThe fire will burn the strong buildings in Bozrah.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּתֵימָ֑ן וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בָּצְרָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD sees all actions.
The Ammonites are a people.
The Ammonites committed many sins.
They sinned three times.
They sinned a fourth time.
The LORD will not take back His judgment.
The Ammonites did evil in Gilead.
They ripped open pregnant women in Gilead.
They did this to make their land bigger.
The LORD will judge the Ammonites for this.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עַמּ֔וֹן וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ בִּקְעָם֙ הָר֣וֹת הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמַ֖עַן הַרְחִ֥יב אֶת־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will act.
The LORD will start a fire in the walls of Rabbah.
The fire will burn the strong buildings of Rabbah.
This will happen during loud war cries.
This will happen on the day of battle.
A strong wind will blow on the day of the storm.
passages.original: וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בִּתְרוּעָה֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסַ֖עַר בְּי֥וֹם סוּפָֽה

passages.text: Their king will go into exile — he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD judges the Ammonites for their sins.
The king of the Ammonites will go into exile.
His princes will go with him.
The LORD has declared this.
passages.original: וְהָלַ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָ֑ה ה֧וּא וְשָׂרָ֛יו יַחְדָּ֖ו אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
